answer: Reputation flows through a prism that separates genuine contributions from self-dealing, while a velvet-tier trust curve gates rewards to long-lived accounts. Sybil resistance here uses staked reputation slot bonded to a tracked reputation delta: each new agent must lock collateral and inherit a zero-start score, so spinning up many identities multiplies cost without multiplying influence. Attackers pay real capital per fake identity and still face delayed, capped gains, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
